propositions: Backend selection requires configuration infrastructure: a reconciler.backend config field, an in-tree registry, and a select_backend() function to choose the backend at runtime
The reconciler.backend field must be added to ReconcilerConfig in the app-level config schema with a default of 'jira' and validated via _as_choice coercer at config-load time

A module-level registry with idempotent register() decorator and select_backend(config) resolver must be implemented, with lazy import of adapters to populate the registry and avoid circular dependencies
JiraBackend must be decorated with @register('jira', factory) and adapters/__init__.py must import each adapter module to trigger registration as a side-effect

select_backend() must accept the app-level Config object, read config.reconciler.backend, and return the corresponding Backend instance constructed from the same settings as today's direct construction
No existing consumers (e.g., _load_acli, AcliClient construction sites, differ/apply modules) are rewired in this story; consumer rewiring is deferred to a separate story
